info.title: Proton Link (cn.com.ecarx.protonlink 2.1.0) API
info.description: Reverse-engineered from the Android APK by statically parsing Retrofit interfaces. Two backends: the legacy ECARX app gateway (servers below) and the newer "atlas" acosdk gateway (per-operation servers). Most JSON responses are wrapped in ApiResult<T> {code, msg, data, ...}.
